passages.context: Item 7/XCV on PL 56 col. 888, artifact PDF p. 450, was visually checked in its adjacent subdeacon, acolyte, lector and doorkeeper sequence. It directs that the exorcist receive from the bishop a booklet in which exorcisms are written and couples that delivery with a spoken commission. The publication uses only the book-delivery and ordinal-sequence architecture, not the operative wording.
